state.message: I was charged twice for the same order. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.

criteria.low: no deadline pressure, customer is only asking
criteria.normal: customer expects an answer within a day
criteria.high: customer is blocked or losing money right now
criteria.critical: customer threatens chargeback or leaves immediately

refund_now.instructions: Should the duplicate charge be refunded without further review?

criteria.true: the evidence already proves the duplicate charge
criteria.false: more checking is needed before refunding

best_action.instructions: What should the support agent do first?

criteria.verify: check the billing records for a duplicate charge
criteria.ask: ask the customer for more details
criteria.escalate: hand the ticket to a billing specialist
